question: How is the divine lotus described in this first octad?
premises: aṣṭa āraṃ paṅkajaṃ divyaṃ prathama aṣṭaka bhūṣitam
the lotus is eight-spoked and divine
it is adorned by the first octad
inference: The divine lotus is eight-spoked and adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: whether prathama modifies aṣṭaka or the whole phrase
plain_english: The divine eight-spoked lotus is adorned by the first octad.
